observations: Photo 0: Used automatic transmission or gearbox, dirty metallic casing, attached starter motor and hoses, blue paint mark on right side, no readable branding.
Photo 1: Side view showing electrical connectors, multicolored wires, sensors, and starter assembly, no readable model number or nameplate.
Photo 2: Bell housing or torque converter cover with circular bolt pattern, no readable branding or part number.
Seller watermark "GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT" appears across all three photos.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; no business registration, shop sign, or inventory shown in photos.

claims.claim: Item is Japanese (implied by dealer description)
claims.evidence: No nameplate, badge, or casting number readable in any photo.

claims.claim: Item works (implied by listing for sale)
claims.evidence: Cannot test operation from still photos.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (gears, clutches, solenoids) unknown
risks.proof: Video of bench test or operation through gear ranges

risks.risk: Actual make or origin unknown; may not be Japanese
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any nameplate, label, or casting number on the casing

risks.risk: Missing components such as torque converter, valve body, or sensors
risks.proof: Full inventory photo showing all included parts

risks.risk: Cracks or external damage to casing not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up panning video of the entire exterior casing

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any nameplate, label, or casting number on the transmission casing
Video of the transmission being bench-tested or shifted through gears
Photo showing whether the torque converter is included
Close-up of the bell housing and oil pan for cracks or leaks
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used automatic transmission from the photos, but no brand or model is readable and its working condition cannot be verified, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unknown-origin unit.
